integrity: Proof identifies every cell of the Hom complex and uses equivariant CW fixed-point criteria; finite verifier is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs of minimum degree at least two and without any four-cycle. The older Walker model may be equivalent; only accessible published descriptions and indexed claims were compared. No external independent validation or certification.
title: Canonical equivariant graph model for box complexes without four-cycles
